## Work with us

::: nm-work

::: nm-card
### Work with us

We welcome students, residents and postdocs interested in neuromuscular disease. Tell us about yourself and what you would like to work on, and we will get back to you.

### Open positions

There are no open positions listed at the moment. Theses, internships and fellowships can be discussed at any time through this form.

<!-- The form posts to Formspree. Create it from this claim link (sign in, then copy the /f/ ID):
     https://formspree.io/claim?name=NeuroMuscle+Lab+-+Work+with+us&project=NeuroMuscle+Lab&field.name=text,required,maxlength:100&field.surname=text,required,maxlength:100&field.email=email,required&field.phone=text,maxlength:40&field.message=text,required,maxlength:5000&field.privacy_consent=text,required
     (form created: xvkavpqz). Set the notification email in Formspree's form settings. -->
<form class="nm-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/xvkavpqz" method="POST">
  <input type="text" name="_gotcha" style="display:none" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" aria-hidden="true">
  <input type="hidden" name="_subject" value="Work with us: new request from neuromusclelab.org">
  <div class="nm-row">
    <div><label for="f-name">Name *</label><input class="form-control" id="f-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="given-name" required></div>
    <div><label for="f-surname">Surname *</label><input class="form-control" id="f-surname" name="surname" type="text" autocomplete="family-name" required></div>
    <div><label for="f-email">E-mail *</label><input class="form-control" id="f-email" name="email" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></div>
    <div><label for="f-phone">Telephone (optional)</label><input class="form-control" id="f-phone" name="phone" type="tel" autocomplete="tel"></div>
  </div>
  <div><label for="f-msg">Message *</label><textarea class="form-control" id="f-msg" name="message" rows="6" required></textarea></div>
  <div class="form-check">
    <input class="form-check-input" id="f-privacy" name="privacy_consent" type="checkbox" value="yes" required>
    <label class="form-check-label" for="f-privacy">I have read the <a href="privacy.html">privacy policy</a> and consent to the processing of my personal data. *</label>
  </div>
  <div><button class="nm-btn nm-btn-muscle" type="submit" style="border: 0">Send request</button></div>
</form>
